review_method: Manual visual inspection of each labeled 2x2 contact sheet at displayed resolution; no VLM or automatic semantic scoring was used.

label_definitions.PASS: The requested condition is visibly satisfied and no material unintended change is apparent outside the requested edit.
label_definitions.PARTIAL: The requested edit is substantially present, but a requested preservation constraint or exact target attribute is imperfect.
label_definitions.FAIL: A central requested edit or preservation constraint is visibly violated.

conditions.0: Preserve the source image materially unchanged.
conditions.A: Make the mug white while keeping the beige vase and flowers unchanged.
conditions.B: Keep the mug black while making the vase blue.
conditions.AB: Make the mug white and the vase blue.

0.label: PASS
0.basis: The black mug, beige vase, flowers, tabletop, books, plant, and background remain materially consistent with the source composition.
0.unintended_collateral_changes: No material collateral change is apparent at contact-sheet resolution.

A.label: PASS
A.basis: The mug is clearly white while the vase remains beige and the flowers/background are preserved.
A.unintended_collateral_changes: Minor mug rendering and placement differences are localized to the edited object.

B.label: PARTIAL
B.basis: The vase becomes blue and the mug remains black, but the mug geometry changes visibly and its handle is no longer apparent.
B.unintended_collateral_changes: The preserved mug is reshaped and shifted, violating strict object preservation despite retaining its black color.

AB.label: PASS
AB.basis: The mug is white and the vase is blue; both requested color edits are clear.
AB.unintended_collateral_changes: Small object-shape and placement changes are visible, but no material edit leaks into the surrounding scene.

0.unintended_collateral_changes: No material collateral change is apparent at contact-sheet resolution.

B.label: FAIL

summary.interpretation: Preservation and single mug recoloring are visually stable, while the vase-only condition exhibits systematic blue leakage into the mug; combined edits are less stable for the mug's exact white target.
